Data.Persona: Enterprise Architect, AI Architect and Business Analyst

ToneOptions.Label: Precise & Technical
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a precise, technical tone, focusing on LLM accuracy, integration protocols, and performance metrics for AI-driven code analysis.

ToneOptions.Label: Security-Focused & Authoritative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a security-focused, authoritative tone, emphasizing vulnerability detection rates, compliance adherence, and risk mitigation for the AI gate.

ToneOptions.Label: Developer-Centric & Actionable
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Use a developer-centric, actionable tone, providing clear, concise feedback and fix suggestions for improved code quality and security.

ToneOptions.Label: Business-Aligned & Strategic
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Convey a business-aligned, strategic tone, highlighting ROI, development velocity improvements, and reduced security incidents through AI assistance.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Security
GoalOptions.Text: To significantly reduce the introduction of security vulnerabilities into production by leveraging LLM-powered static analysis. Success is measured by a quantifiable decrease in OWASP Top 10 findings in deployed code and a higher average security score for pull requests.

GoalOptions.Label: Accelerate Development
GoalOptions.Text: To streamline the code review process and enable faster, more confident code deployments. Success means developers receive immediate, actionable feedback on their pull requests, reducing review cycle times and increasing overall development velocity.

GoalOptions.Label: Improve Code Quality
GoalOptions.Text: To proactively identify and remediate architectural anti-patterns and performance regressions early in the development lifecycle. Success is demonstrated by a reduction in post-deployment bug reports related to these issues and adherence to defined architectural standards.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize AI Performance
GoalOptions.Text: To ensure the AI-Assisted Code Review & Security Gate operates with high accuracy and low latency, providing timely and reliable feedback. Success is defined by meeting or exceeding targets for vulnerability detection accuracy and PR feedback response time.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Performance & Accuracy
Criteria: Achieve >95% accuracy in detecting OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
Maintain an average pull request analysis latency of < 60 seconds.
Demonstrate seamless integration with GitHub and GitLab APIs.
Ensure LLM response confidence scores correlate with actual vulnerability severity.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Security & Compliance
Criteria: Reduce critical and high-severity security findings in production by 80% within 6 months.
Ensure all detected vulnerabilities are mapped to relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Provide auditable logs of all security findings and remediation actions.
Minimize false positive rates for security vulnerability detection to < 5%.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Development Efficiency & Usability
Criteria: Reduce average code review time by 30% through automated AI feedback.
Provide clear, actionable code suggestions that developers can implement in < 5 minutes.
Achieve a developer satisfaction score of > 4.0/5.0 for the AI review experience.
Ensure the tool integrates smoothly into existing IDEs and CI/CD workflows with minimal configuration.
